answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Seated loan officer certificate with lenders council attestation. It requires a certificate the council renews after file audits, so the prism of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm doing the maths finds the forge first: a hundred clones need a hundred proofs, and the epoch reward divided a hundred ways is already less than the cost of one. The thread is that the same proof cannot serve two names.
